evidence.claim: Model knowledge: mechanical CAD supports parameterised component families and repeated feature patterns.

tasks.design: Configure native dimensional comparison and catalogue numbering in {MATERIAL_REGISTER}, denoted OTHER. Final material record approval precedes separate commit with no same-system save benefit.

tasks.enabler_now: Native numeric rules and catalogue uniqueness checks can assist exact checks and number selection.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable measurement and distinguishing similar but non-equivalent materials.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter detects mismatched physical material and resolves ambiguous identity.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a material register can compare numeric dimensions and enforce unique catalogue numbers using native rules.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; confirm residual manual comparison and number lookup after existing register functions. Measurement remains full; current auto-numbering earns no benefit.
